ops.body:
Adopted binding contract delta 1 as cc-notes doc 64803ab. It came from an independent cross-check of the synthesis against the settled contracts; the root-rejected items were not reintroduced.
- D1: optional allowlisted Orca recoveryLaunch (snapshot off / append prompt). Used only if the fixtures prove plain resume insufficient and the destination advertises the flag.
- D2: Orca import sessionIdMap for explicit forks.
- D3: verbatim relay of origin blocks gated on artifact closure only; equal-revision conflict gives no ACK.
- D4: max-wait 10 s coalescing in the deliverer (the watch engine's trailing debounce could starve delivery); cc-sync debounce is 2 s.
- D5: GCGrace/StagingTTL are 24 h; apply.v2 pins all roots; partial-capture pins; codesnap.Has = index AND store.
- D6: revisions = max(prev+1, UnixMicro), with fences kept.
- D7: a deferred or incomplete code capture still protects the sessions, using the last complete code manifest; code_state, code_captured_at and the code age are shown.
- D8: the policy recheck covers every non-control peer call, and the receiver checks have/apply.v2.
- D9: PutGroup splits into group trees; the closure bound is per root; MaxRoots is 8192 with an overflow rule.
- D10: supersede at batch boundaries during TRANSFER.
- D11: the monorepo fetch/Verify runs in the background, outside the exclusive apply.
- D12: pickup passes --register-repo, reports per-session refused status, and expires pickup pins after 24 h.
- D13 (root requirement 20:13Z): capture is gated on a code WIP stamp (reposync worktree.Stamp: HEAD, index stat, porcelain-v2 records, and an lstat of dirty/untracked paths computed at due time, with git pruning ignored dirs), plus configurable tier intervals/windows in <Dir>/config.json and an E2E fixture for code-only edits.
Execution: reposync Stamp Run wf_6a709856-b3c (branch cc-sync/worktree-stamp, worktree /Users/yasyf/.claude/worktrees/reposync/stamp, from foundation 436cf13, new files only; codex review + fix). The in-flight synckit/reposync/Orca workflows finish their current scope; per-repo delta lanes then apply D1–D12 before the final cross-repo review. cc-sync stage B2 applies D3/D5–D7/D9/D11–D13 on the cc-sync side.
